title: Adjoints of Morphisms of Neural Codes
summary: A combinatorial code $\mathcal{C}$ is a collection of subsets of $[n]$, or equivalently a set of points in $\{0,1\}^n$. A morphism of codes is a map from one combinatorial code to another such that the coordinates of points in the image can be expressed as products of coordinates in the domain. By representing morphisms of codes as binary matrices, we show that any morphism of codes is part of a Galois connection where its adjoint is boolean multiplication by the representative matrix.
